name: pr-board
description: A pane of open pull requests (mine, other people's, bots') with labels, CI and review state, filters, snoozing, and buttons to open, chat, approve, merge or run getsentry tests.

queries.title: GitHub searches
queries.description: Semicolon-separated GitHub PR searches to list (is:pr is:open is added). Example: author:@me; review-requested:@me; org:getsentry author:app/dependabot

codeRoots.title: Code folders
codeRoots.description: Comma-separated folders holding your clones (as <root>/<repo> or <root>/<owner>/<repo>); a new chat about a PR starts in its clone.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the list reloads in the background; 0 turns it off.
